answers.rationale: Award A-101 has an award amount of 50,000 (awards.csv). Recorded disbursements total 35,000 (20,000 on 2024-02-15 plus 15,000 on 2024-06-15 in disbursements.csv). Per program_rules.txt, remaining obligation equals award amount minus sum of disbursements: 50,000 − 35,000 = 15,000.
Award A-102 is a SEED-FAST award (awards.csv). program_rules.txt states that SEED-FAST awards have no cash-match requirement.
status_fragment.txt establishes that legend code A means Active. awards.csv shows status_code A for A-101 and A-102. No other awards carry code A.

Award A-101 is SEED-CORE with an award amount of 50,000 (awards.csv). program_rules.txt requires a cash match equal to 20% of the award amount for SEED-CORE awards unless a written waiver is on file. 20% of 50,000 = 10,000. The packet does not include a waiver letter for A-101, so the applicable rule yields a required match of 10,000.

Award A-104 has status_code S (awards.csv), but status_fragment.txt is a partial legend listing only A (Active) and C (Closed). It explicitly states that other codes are used by finance and are not listed here. The packet does not define what S means.

Award A-105 is SEED-CORE (awards.csv), which normally requires a 20% cash match unless a written waiver is on file (program_rules.txt). The packet does not attach waiver letters, and program_rules.txt notes that absence of a waiver in this packet is not a denial that one exists elsewhere. No source establishes whether a waiver was granted for A-105.
